UPDATE ht_room_types SET type_code = $1, type_name = $2, type_name_en = $3, type_description = $4, type_base_price = $5::float8, type_max_guests = $6, type_bed_type = $7, type_size_sqm = $8::float8, type_amenities = $9, type_sort_order = $10, type_active = $11, type_updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE type_id = $12
